subject: [PATCH 1/6] NFSD: Add per-export read/write I/O mode settings

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch adds per-export read/write I/O mode settings to the NFS server (NFSD). It introduces two new fields, `ex_riomode` and `ex_wiomode`, in the `struct svc_export` structure. These fields are used to store the I/O modes for reading and writing, respectively. The patch also updates the netlink specification to include these new fields and adds policy checks to ensure their validity. Additionally, it modifies the cache update logic to copy the settings from the netlink attributes to the export's internal state. This allows administrators to configure different I/O modes for each export on a per-export basis.
